title: Add native joint centre-query transfers on sixteen selected ports
body:
This **local construction and enabling theorem** uses two disjoint eight-port minors to carry centre queries in the joint X/Y state. It gives invertible forward and backward data maps, preserves all **sixteen selected X-plus-Y sums**, and allocates no new array field. Changing the selected source baseline permits a local query exchange without a Schur-unit assumption. The package supplies **37 complete native local words** for the actual historical complex supplier.

**The complete kappa bound is unchanged.** This is a reusable local operator interface, not a complete changing-chart controller. The package includes an exact witness against the current controller's selected-only recovery interface and states the remaining escapes.

Evidence at the reviewed commit: [ordered proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/JOINT-QUERY-TRANSFER.md), [literal native certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/certificate.json.gz), [independent package review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/PACKAGE-REVIEW.md), [replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/REPLAY.json), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/SOURCES.json).

The ordered theorem uses disjoint selected sets A and T, their complement U, `K=K_A+P+K_U`, `J=I-KR`, `RP=LP=I`, and the stated support conditions, with `PL` the T-coordinate projector. The forward companion also uses `RK_A=I`. Put

```text
M=R K_U,  Z=K_U-PM,  H=I+ZR.
RZ=0,  H^-1=I-ZR,  JH=I-[K_A+P(I+M)]R.
```

No inverse of M and no interchange of ordered factors is used; M may be noncentral or singular. A future A-logger `E_t=I+N_t`, with only A output rows and no A input columns, supplies the second chart's record. In the conserved backward map, let `u=E_t y`, `a=ell_s x`, and `b=R_s u`. Its records are

```text
R_s y' = a,
ell_(t,A) y' = R_t y,
ell_s x' = b + M a.
```

The selected X record is `b+Ma`, not b alone. The ordinary target rows perform `x_U-y_U`. The forward companion puts the full current X query in T and moves the old T query into A. Both maps preserve each selected pair sum and have explicit algebraic inverses in both orders. The conserved sums are logical identities; their X and Y terms have different native endpoint frames. The words are companions, not inverse circuits. The actual instance has `R` of size 8 by 112, `K=R^T/4`, and `M=12I`. The general theorem is algebraic; the priced native instances use these actual dyadic matrices.

The [native contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/CONSERVED-QQ16.md) supplies all 28 `B_s_t` cases for `1 <= s < t <= 8` and all nine `F_s` cases for `0 <= s <= 8`. Its cover views change the owner and apply a separate payload translation on every tensor layer. Each full-cover sweep must finish before the next event. A private row body completes at one owner before C0 is reused at the next. The new work uses one existing owned C0 field. All 480 ordinary helpers retain their arbitrary logical values and prescribed native endpoint frames; all eight owned private inputs may be arbitrary, are discarded, and have zero outputs.

| Complete local word | Real scalar primitive bound | Added rank-one children | Native rank mass | Added cover maps | Native wrapper maps |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Backward `B_s_t` | 214986 | 24 | 5546 | 528 | 48 |
| Forward `F_s`, `s > 0` | 211210 | 8 | 5530 | 288 | 16 |
| Forward `F_0` | 211210 | 8 | 5530 | 0 | 16 |

The retained core contributes scalar bound 202138 and native mass 5522 to each row. These are local counts in the retained normalization. Map counts are not a stream or address implementation price. Formal scalar prefix guards are 73 bits backward and 55 bits forward; they are not recursive precision bounds.

The exact branch and source base is [`bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f). The runtime input is the frozen [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) [selected-replay archive](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz), also used by the historical [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) assembly. [PR #1862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1862) supplied the preceding source-code construction and the [unchanged source loader at commit 7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7649d9ceecec949541bec4bbde5929344166ba59/research/native-source-codes/source_data.py). That loader is included here; this package has no runtime dependency on a PR branch or predecessor Python package.

With Python 3.10 or later, its standard library, Git, and the base object present locally, run one process from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/joint-query/replay.py --repo . --out /tmp/qq16-replay
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_PORTABLE_QQ16_LOCAL_JOINT_QUERY
37 native cases; 712 scalar input columns per orientation; 16384 exact new native columns.
B: scalar 214986, native mass 5546. F: scalar 211210, native mass 5530.
Local construction only. The complete supplier and kappa calculation are not established.
```

Root and isolated independent cold replays passed with byte-identical mathematical receipts. The independent package run copied only the declared files and used `-I -O -B`; all checks remain active under `-O`. Verification covers both 712-column common-chart scalar maps, both data inverse orders, algebraic composition, all helpers and private outputs, all sixteen selected sums, all 1008 actual chart routes, all 37 native paths, and 16384 exact Gaussian columns including scalar phases. Timing, private-clear, inverse-sign, translation, wrong-owner, phase and odd-denominator controls pass. The independent audit also rejects a wrong owner map that preserves the phase ledger.

The [controller witness](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/QQ16-SELECTED-WITNESS.md) and its [independent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/QQ16-RATIONAL-OBSERVATION-REVIEW.md) show that the fixed first conserved F0/B1 pair and retained ordinary bank schedule cannot restore every selected input from selected outputs, completed-X descendants, and all five F query histories, even over the rationals. Later homogeneous selected-only linear controls do not remove this witness. Changed first-pair maps, ordinary-to-selected reads, affine helper state, and paid query operations remain outside its scope.

The [bridge proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/evidence/BRIDGE-REVIEW.md) supplies the inherited core embedding and endpoint adapters. Core bytes and local frames are checked again; the old recursive child kernels and the global controller witness are not rerun by this entrypoint. Algebraic inverse formulas do not establish legal inverse reads at native output frames. New child/helper hosting, controller closure, endpoint recovery, stream/address costs, recursive precision, and the complete supplier invoice remain open. No complete supplier replay, repository-wide suite, or new kappa calculation was run for this local package.

Related work, not a consumed dependency, is Chafik Boukhalfa's (@chafreaky) [PR #1877](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1877). Its [proof at 6d455d2d71eb35ecf8e562711e5f719b994fe3f3](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d455d2d71eb35ecf8e562711e5f719b994fe3f3/research/sourcecode-commutant/PROOF.md) gives source-only endpoint-support and fixed-read frame obstructions. The present source depends on old X_T and uses explicit native transitions. It does not assume free commutation through the fixed source frames. No code or certificate from that PR is consumed.

The retained [gauge notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/NOTICE.md) credits @icekylinx. The [t16 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/t16/NOTICE.md) credits Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) for integration, Jeremy Kothe (@jeremykothe2) for the [PR #799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799) local supplier, and Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky) for the [PR #741](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/741) frame work. The [slot-word source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots/README.md) credits @rohanarun for [PR #987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/987) and NewBArch for [PR #869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/869); no account is inferred for NewBArch. The original notices, complete earlier lineage, and campaign contribution chronology are retained in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/NOTICE.md) and its linked source notices.

New research, implementation, and independent agent review used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance under the user's direction. No independent human review is claimed. New material uses Apache-2.0. The [open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7/research/joint-query/README.md) identify the remaining controller, hosting, and complete-cost work.
